page.title: 長い副詞句と頻度のニュアンス

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、once every two weeks・three times a week・at the end of each month・from time to time など、複数語からなる時間・頻度の副詞句を扱う。長い副詞句は文末に置くのが自然で、話題として強調するときは文頭に置いてコンマで区切る。often・occasionally・hardly ever・never の頻度差も区別する。
grammarPoints: 回数は once・twice・three times と期間を組み合わせて表す
every other + 単数名詞は一つおきの周期を表す
長い時間・頻度の副詞句は通常文末に置く
副詞句を文頭へ出すときはコンマで主節と区切る
from time to time・occasionally・sometimes は低～中程度の頻度を表す
hardly ever はほぼゼロ、never は完全なゼロを表す
visualEvidence: 短い頻度副詞と長い副詞句が別のカードで並び、文中位置の違いを示している
カレンダー上の隔週・月末・週3回の印が、回数と期間の組合せを視覚化している
長い副詞句が文末の広いスペースへ置かれるレールと、文頭へ移動してコンマを伴うレールが対比されている
頻度メーター上で often・occasionally・hardly ever・never が異なる位置に配置されている
commonTraps: once every two weeks と twice a week を混同する
every other weeks のように every other の後ろを複数形にする
長い副詞句を一般動詞と目的語の間へ挟む
文頭の長い副詞句の後ろにコンマを置かない
hardly ever に not を重ねる
never を「めったにない」と弱く解釈する

questions.prompt: The audit team meets ------- to review unresolved compliance issues.

choices.A: once every two weeks
choices.B: twice every day
choices.C: rare
choices.D: one time weeks

questions.translationJa: 監査チームは未解決のコンプライアンス問題を確認するため、2週間に1回会合を開きます。
questions.explanationJa: once every two weeks は「2週間ごとに1回」を表す長い頻度句です。回数と期間の組合せが自然です。

questions.prompt: -------, the warehouse closes early for a full electrical inspection.

choices.A: Every occasion rare
choices.B: On rare occasions
choices.C: Occasionally every
choices.D: At never occasions

questions.translationJa: まれに、倉庫は全面的な電気点検のため早く閉まります。
questions.explanationJa: On rare occasions は低頻度の出来事を文頭で話題化する副詞句で、後ろをコンマで区切ります。

questions.prompt: Under the current policy, employees may work remotely -------.

choices.A: two day a weeks
choices.B: every twice days
choices.C: two days a week
choices.D: occasionally day

questions.translationJa: 現在の方針では、従業員は週2日リモート勤務ができます。
questions.explanationJa: two days a week は「1週間につき2日」を表します。day は複数、week は基準期間として単数です。

questions.prompt: The air filter is replaced -------, not every day.

choices.A: each at month end
choices.B: hardly every end
choices.C: three month at times
choices.D: at the end of each month

questions.translationJa: エアフィルターは毎日ではなく、毎月末に交換されます。
questions.explanationJa: at the end of each month は各月の終わりを表す長い時間句で、通常は文末に置きます。
questions.focus: at the end of each month

questions.prompt: The regional supervisor visits the night shift ------- to speak with employees directly.

choices.A: from time to time
choices.B: at no time
choices.C: every times
choices.D: two time a day

questions.translationJa: 地域責任者は時折、従業員と直接話すため夜勤を訪れます。
questions.explanationJa: from time to time は「時々」を表し、規則的ではない低～中頻度の訪問に合います。

questions.prompt: Payroll statements are issued ------- under the new schedule.

choices.A: every others Friday
choices.B: every other Friday
choices.C: every Friday other
choices.D: Friday every twice

questions.translationJa: 新しい日程では、給与明細は隔週の金曜日に発行されます。
questions.explanationJa: every other Friday は「1週おきの金曜日」を表します。every other の後ろは単数名詞です。

questions.prompt: The reception team ------- arranges taxis for guests whose flights leave before dawn.

choices.A: occasion
choices.B: every occasions
choices.C: occasionally
choices.D: neverly

questions.translationJa: 受付チームは時折、夜明け前に出発する便の利用客のためタクシーを手配します。
questions.explanationJa: occasionally は不定期に時々起こることを表し、一般動詞 arranges の前に置きます。

questions.prompt: The backup server is ------- unavailable because maintenance is performed without interrupting service.

choices.A: not hardly
choices.B: every hard
choices.C: occasionally never
choices.D: hardly ever

questions.translationJa: 保守作業はサービスを止めずに行われるため、バックアップサーバーが利用不能になることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: hardly ever は「ほとんど決して～ない」という非常に低い頻度を表します。not は重ねません。

questions.prompt: The cafeteria menu changes -------, giving employees several new options each week.

choices.A: three times a week
choices.B: third time weeks
choices.C: three time every weeks
choices.D: once three week

questions.translationJa: 社員食堂のメニューは週3回変わり、毎週いくつかの新しい選択肢が提供されます。
questions.explanationJa: three times a week は「1週間につき3回」を表します。複数回なので times を使います。

questions.prompt: -------, deliveries to mountain branches may be delayed by heavy snow.

choices.A: Frequently the winters
choices.B: During the winter months
choices.C: At every snow
choices.D: Hardly monthly winter

questions.translationJa: 冬の数か月間は、大雪により山間部の支店への配送が遅れることがあります。
questions.explanationJa: During the winter months は期間を表す長い副詞句です。文頭に置き、コンマで主節と区切ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating when quarterly results are reported.

choices.A: The sales team at the end of every quarter reports its results at.
choices.B: The sales team reports at the end its results every quarter of.
choices.C: The sales team reports its results at the end of every quarter.
choices.D: The sales team reports its results every at quarter the end.

questions.translationJa: 営業チームは各四半期末に実績を報告します。
questions.explanationJa: 目的語 its results の後ろに長い時間句 at the end of every quarter を置く語順が自然です。
questions.focus: 長い時間句の文末位置

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an infrequent schedule change.

choices.A: On rare occasions the final train, leaves from a different platform.
choices.B: Rare on occasions, the final train leaves from a different platform.
choices.C: On rarely occasions the final train leaves, from a different platform.
choices.D: On rare occasions, the final train leaves from a different platform.

questions.translationJa: まれに、最終列車が別のホームから出発します。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭の On rare occasions の直後にコンマを置き、主節を続けるのが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an occasional online seminar.

choices.A: We sometimes hold product seminars online for overseas clients.
choices.B: We hold sometimes product seminars online for overseas clients.
choices.C: We are sometimes hold product seminars online for overseas clients.
choices.D: We sometime holds product seminars online for overseas clients.

questions.translationJa: 当社は海外顧客向けの商品セミナーを時々オンラインで開催します。
questions.explanationJa: 短い頻度副詞 sometimes は一般動詞 hold の前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an almost-never closure.

choices.A: The branch does not hardly ever close because of bad weather.
choices.B: The branch hardly ever closes because of bad weather.
choices.C: The branch hardly closes ever because of bad weather.
choices.D: The branch is hardly ever close because of bad weather.

questions.translationJa: その支店が悪天候のため閉まることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: hardly ever 自体が低頻度を表すため not は不要で、一般動詞 closes の前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a twice-monthly inspection.

choices.A: The emergency generators are inspected twice months.
choices.B: The emergency generators twice are inspect a month.
choices.C: The emergency generators are inspected twice a month.
choices.D: The emergency generators are inspected two times month a.

questions.translationJa: 非常用発電機は月2回点検されます。
questions.explanationJa: twice a month は「1か月につき2回」を表す定型的な頻度句で、文末に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an alternating Tuesday meeting.

choices.A: Every others Tuesday, the design committee reviews open issues.
choices.B: Every Tuesday other the design committee, reviews open issues.
choices.C: Every other Tuesdays, the design committee reviews open issues.
choices.D: Every other Tuesday, the design committee reviews open issues.

questions.translationJa: 隔週の火曜日に、設計委員会は未解決事項を確認します。
questions.explanationJa: every other の後ろは単数形 Tuesday です。文頭の句の後ろにはコンマを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about occasional weekend work.

choices.A: The finance manager occasionally works on Saturday during budget season.
choices.B: The finance manager works occasionally on Saturday during budget season.
choices.C: The finance manager occasional works on Saturday during budget season.
choices.D: The finance manager is occasionally work on Saturday during budget season.

questions.translationJa: 予算期には、財務責任者が時折土曜日に勤務します。
questions.explanationJa: occasionally は一般動詞 works の前に置く頻度副詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating the publication cycle of a newsletter.

choices.A: The customer newsletter is published one every three month.
choices.B: The customer newsletter is published once every three months.
choices.C: The customer newsletter once is publish every three months.
choices.D: The customer newsletter is published three once every months.

questions.translationJa: 顧客向けニュースレターは3か月に1回発行されます。
questions.explanationJa: once every three months は「3か月ごとに1回」を表し、受動態の後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing irregular review visits.

choices.A: From time to time an external reviewer, visits the laboratory.
choices.B: From times to time, an external reviewer visit the laboratory.
choices.C: From time to time, an external reviewer visits the laboratory.
choices.D: Time from to time, an external reviewer visits the laboratory.

questions.translationJa: 時折、外部の審査員が研究所を訪れます。
questions.explanationJa: From time to time は固定表現で、文頭に置く場合はコンマを続けます。
questions.focus: From time to time の形

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing a strict overnight rule.

choices.A: The loading dock never is left unlocked overnight.
choices.B: The loading dock is not never left unlocked overnight.
choices.C: The loading dock is left never unlock overnight.
choices.D: The loading dock is never left unlocked overnight.

questions.translationJa: 積み込み場が夜間に施錠されないままになることは決してありません。
questions.explanationJa: 受動態では never を be動詞 is の後に置きます。not never は二重否定になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The committee meets once every two weeks.”

choices.A: The committee holds one meeting in each two-week period.
choices.B: The committee meets twice every week.
choices.C: The committee has no regular meetings.
choices.D: The committee meets only once each year.

questions.translationJa: 委員会は2週間に1回会合を開きます。
questions.explanationJa: once every two weeks は、各2週間の期間に会合が1回あることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Ms. Ali occasionally assists at the reception desk.”

choices.A: Ms. Ali works at reception every day.
choices.B: Ms. Ali helps at the reception desk sometimes, but not often.
choices.C: Ms. Ali has never helped at reception.
choices.D: Reception is Ms. Ali’s only permanent assignment.

questions.translationJa: アリさんは時折受付を手伝います。
questions.explanationJa: occasionally は「時々だが頻繁ではない」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The printer hardly ever jams.”

choices.A: The printer jams several times a day.
choices.B: The printer has been permanently removed.
choices.C: The printer almost never has a paper jam.
choices.D: Every print job causes a paper jam.

questions.translationJa: そのプリンターが紙詰まりを起こすことはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: hardly ever は almost never とほぼ同じ非常に低い頻度を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The inventory data is frequently revised.”

choices.A: The inventory data is never changed.
choices.B: The data was revised only when the system launched.
choices.C: The inventory data is always incorrect.
choices.D: The inventory data is updated many times.

questions.translationJa: 在庫データは頻繁に改訂されます。
questions.explanationJa: frequently revised は、改訂が何度も行われることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Training is held every other Monday.”

choices.A: Training takes place on alternate Mondays.
choices.B: Training is held every Monday without exception.
choices.C: Training occurs twice each Monday.
choices.D: Training is never scheduled on Monday.

questions.translationJa: 研修は隔週の月曜日に行われます。
questions.explanationJa: every other Monday は alternate Mondays、つまり1週おきの月曜日という意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The temperature is recorded twice a day.”

choices.A: A temperature reading is taken every two days.
choices.B: Two temperature readings are taken each day.
choices.C: The temperature is checked only twice a year.
choices.D: Two days are needed for each reading.

questions.translationJa: 温度は1日2回記録されます。
questions.explanationJa: twice a day は「各日に2回」を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “A consultant visits from time to time.”

choices.A: A consultant is present at all times.
choices.B: The consultant visits at exactly the same hour every day.
choices.C: A consultant visits on some occasions, without a fixed frequent schedule.
choices.D: No consultant has ever visited.

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントが時折訪問します。
questions.explanationJa: from time to time は不定期に時々起こることを表します。
questions.focus: from time to time の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Statements are sent at the end of each month.”

choices.A: Statements are sent at the beginning of every day.
choices.B: Statements are never sent monthly.
choices.C: Several statements are sent every hour.
choices.D: Statements are sent once each month when that month is ending.

questions.translationJa: 明細書は毎月末に送られます。
questions.explanationJa: at the end of each month は、各月が終わる時点を指します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Visitors are never allowed in the server room alone.”

choices.A: There is no occasion when a visitor may enter the server room alone.
choices.B: Visitors may sometimes enter alone.
choices.C: Visitors are usually alone in the server room.
choices.D: Only visitors may enter the room without staff.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者が1人でサーバールームに入ることは決して許可されません。
questions.explanationJa: never は例外のないゼロ頻度を表し、no occasion と言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Green works at the branch three days a week.”

choices.A: Mr. Green works at the branch every weekday.
choices.B: Mr. Green spends three working days at the branch in a typical week.
choices.C: Mr. Green visits the branch once every three weeks.
choices.D: Mr. Green works only three days each year.

questions.translationJa: グリーンさんは週3日その支店で勤務します。
questions.explanationJa: three days a week は、通常の1週間のうち3日勤務することを表します。

questions.prompt: The operations staff has a standing meeting on the first Wednesday of every month. -------

choices.A: The staff meets once every Wednesday.
choices.B: The staff hardly ever meets in any month.
choices.C: The staff meets once a month.
choices.D: The staff meets twelve times a week.

questions.translationJa: 運営スタッフは毎月第1水曜日に定例会議を行います。スタッフは月1回会います。
questions.explanationJa: 毎月特定の日に1回なので once a month が正しい要約です。

questions.prompt: The coastal depot normally operates until 8:00 P.M. Only severe storms cause it to close earlier. -------

choices.A: The depot closes early every evening.
choices.B: The depot is never affected by weather.
choices.C: On every occasions the depot, closes early.
choices.D: On rare occasions, the depot closes early.

questions.translationJa: 沿岸部の倉庫は通常午後8時まで稼働し、早く閉まるのは激しい嵐のときだけです。まれに早く閉まります。
questions.explanationJa: severe storms only という条件から、低頻度を表す On rare occasions が合います。

questions.prompt: The ordering platform went offline only twice during the past four years. -------

choices.A: The platform is hardly ever unavailable.
choices.B: The platform is unavailable every week.
choices.C: The platform has never operated.
choices.D: The platform is not hardly ever available.

questions.translationJa: 発注プラットフォームが停止したのは過去4年間で2回だけです。利用できなくなることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: 4年間で2回は非常に低い頻度なので hardly ever が適切です。

questions.prompt: The magazine is released in January, April, July, and October. -------

choices.A: It is published three times every month.
choices.B: It is published once every three months.
choices.C: It is published once every four years.
choices.D: It is never published in the winter.

questions.translationJa: その雑誌は1月、4月、7月、10月に発行されます。3か月に1回発行されます。
questions.explanationJa: 発行月の間隔が3か月なので once every three months と表せます。

questions.prompt: Security updates are scheduled every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. -------

choices.A: The system is updated once every three weeks.
choices.B: The system is never updated on weekdays.
choices.C: The system is updated three times a week.
choices.D: The system updates three week times.

questions.translationJa: セキュリティ更新は毎週月・水・金曜日に予定されています。システムは週3回更新されます。
questions.explanationJa: 1週間に指定曜日が3日あるため three times a week が正解です。
questions.focus: three times a week の文脈

questions.prompt: The supplier delivers packaging materials on alternating Thursdays. -------

choices.A: Deliveries arrive twice every Thursday.
choices.B: Deliveries arrive every Thursday without exception.
choices.C: Deliveries never arrive on Thursday.
choices.D: Deliveries arrive every other Thursday.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は隔週の木曜日に梱包資材を届けます。配送は1週おきの木曜日に到着します。
questions.explanationJa: alternating Thursdays は every other Thursday と同じ意味です。

questions.prompt: An ergonomics consultant visits several times a year, but the dates are not fixed. -------

choices.A: The consultant comes from time to time.
choices.B: The consultant is always in the office.
choices.C: The consultant comes at the same time every day.
choices.D: The consultant never visits the office.

questions.translationJa: 人間工学のコンサルタントは年に数回訪れますが、日程は固定されていません。コンサルタントは時折来ます。
questions.explanationJa: 不定期で年に数回という文脈には from time to time が合います。
questions.focus: 不定期の from time to time

questions.prompt: Employees may choose any two weekdays for remote work, subject to team coverage. -------

choices.A: They must work remotely every weekday.
choices.B: They may work remotely two days a week.
choices.C: They may work remotely once every two weeks.
choices.D: They may choose two weeks for each remote day.

questions.translationJa: 従業員はチームの要員確保を条件に、任意の平日2日を在宅勤務日に選べます。週2日在宅勤務ができます。
questions.explanationJa: any two weekdays は、1週間につき2日という意味です。
questions.focus: two days a week の文脈

questions.prompt: Database maintenance starts on the first night of every calendar month. -------

choices.A: Maintenance occurs at the end of every day.
choices.B: Maintenance never has a monthly schedule.
choices.C: Maintenance occurs at the beginning of each month.
choices.D: Maintenance occurs three times each night.

questions.translationJa: データベース保守は毎月最初の夜に始まります。保守は毎月初めに行われます。
questions.explanationJa: the first night of every month は at the beginning of each month とまとめられます。
questions.focus: at the beginning of each month

questions.prompt: Company policy requires the rear entrance to remain locked whenever no guard is present. There are no exceptions. -------

choices.A: The entrance is occasionally left open without a guard.
choices.B: The entrance is hardly ever locked.
choices.C: The entrance is unlocked every other night.
choices.D: The entrance is never left unlocked without a guard.

questions.translationJa: 会社方針では警備員がいないときは裏口を施錠し、例外はありません。警備員なしで裏口が無施錠になることは決してありません。
questions.explanationJa: no exceptions はゼロ頻度を示すため never が最適です。受動態では is never left とします。
